Expected results

  • Step 1: the page loads normally.
  • Step 2: the Column Selection and Card size changes apply at once.
  • Step 3: the card moves to Ben's column and the message "{work order number} assigned to ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" appears, with an "Undo" button, showing Alpha Co's work order number (for example "S1-801 assigned to ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo").
  • Step 4: after the refresh, Board View, VIN/Serial, Compact and Ben as lead are all still there. Analytics being blocked made no difference.

3 Nov 2026, QA lead’s decision: step 2 says Card size instead of density, because Board View has no density control; its spacing control is Card size (PRD version 82, S3-R11 and S3-R11a).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S12-N1 and S4-R5, read 19 Oct 2026. In versions 66 to 68 (19 Oct 2026) the message after a lead change became "{work order number} assigned to {technician name}", with Undo; the step 3 result follows. Re-read against PRD version 82 (29 Oct 2026) on 2 Nov 2026: the quoted rules are unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-N1: “Analytics failure, opt-out, or unavailability must not block loading, preference changes, or reassignment.”
  • S4-R5: “After a successful lead change on Board View or Tech View, whether by drag, the dialog or Unassign, show the design’s toast (white, with the check icon) with an Undo button. It reads “{work order number} assigned to {technician name}”; “{work order number} lead technician set to {technician name}” when the new lead was already the technician on at least one of the work order’s lines; or “{work order number} moved to Unassigned” after removing the lead. Examples: “S1-357 assigned to Esther Howard”, “S1-702 lead technician set to Ralph Edwards”, “S1-352 moved to Unassigned”. This replaces the standard success toast for these messages only.”
  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control (SV-11580). Its spacing control is Card size (S3-R11a), which sits beside Column Selection between the toolbar’s two dividers, as in the design.”
  • S3-R11a: “Card size offers Detailed (the default) and Compact. It changes the work order cards only; columns, column order and sorting stay the same.”

Last checked against build v26.43.5-77de68c (production) on 11/2/2026.
